The '''Tarabba system''' was located in the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], which linked it to the [[Denab system/Legends|Denab]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Tantra system/Legends|Tantra systems]].<ref name="Tantra">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'' places the [[Tantra system/Legends|Tantra system]], which {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} establishes to have been a part of the [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]], [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] from the [[Adarlon system/Legends|Adarlon system]] on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} further depicts the Rimma Trade Route traveling through, in Coreward direction, from the Adarlon [[Star system/Legends|system]] through the Tantra [[Sector/Legends|sector]] before reaching the Tarabba system, meaning that the Tantra system was situated between the Tarabba and Adarlon systems.</ref>

The Tarabba [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> contained the celestial body [[Tarabba Prime/Legends|Tarabba Prime]], which was the nearest major shipping and communications hub to<ref name="CV16" /> the Tarabba [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Utapau system/Legends|Utapau system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The former system was also the site of a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] depot<ref name="Depot" /> that was successfully [[Battle of Tarabba|attacked]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="3 ABY">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]] establishes that [[Tenk Lenso]], who [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], also participated in the [[Battle of Tarabba|attack]] on the Tarabba [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] depot. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of Hoth to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tarabba system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA" />
